Remark
[Euclidean length minimization]

Source: petersen:page-0054 ↗ rem:pet-ch1-ex-16 ↗ ex:pet-ch1-euclidean-space

1. ch1:1.6.19Every curve between two points of Euclidean space has length at least the Euclidean distance between them. Equality is possible only when its image lies in the connecting segment. This follows by projecting the curve onto the unit vector parallel to that segment.

The next algebraic obstruction supplies the flat-immersion conclusions used in the spherical and hyperbolic exercises without importing the geodesic theory of later chapters.
